hold_text: PHONE-EXEC-OBSERVABLE-1018 PR 3 (manager session_01VduHYzdaXe27wTDBLSu8ao; operator decision 2026-10-18). Stacked on PR 6 (#18937, the bounded test-trade path) and #18936 (the mandate record). Tier 3 by content: besides the REHEARSAL drill server half -- src/prop/phone_drill.py (request file beside the journal, atomic claim with the position the server expects, per-step result history, claim timeout), POST /phone/drill/claim + /phone/drill/result, GET /phone/pending carries `drill`, GET /api/diag/phone_drill, the Tier-1 `phone-drill` system-action, and the SERVER-side sheet-edit gate (claim config `sheet_edit` = 3 consecutive drill passes or an explicit phone_accounts.<acct>.sheet_edit pin, replacing the app's build constant) -- a drill requested WITH `symbol:` is a drill with a TEST TRADE under the operator's mandate MD-EXEC-DEV-TEST-TRADES: the server writes ONE minimum-size exec-test ticket at claim (every bound checked at request, at claim and when the phone claims the ticket; a refusal is a failed drill that writes nothing), the app places it, amends its stop INCLUDING Confirm, reads back and CLOSES it, and the server journals the close as a fill on the ticket. A position reported open or a test drill that never reports is ONE Telegram naming the ticket to close by hand; nothing halts. A drill without `symbol:` keeps its no-Confirm, no-close contract. Revert = revert this PR (sheet_edit then reads absent = false on the app: no click; no test ticket can be written).
why: operator 2026-10-18: a drill that runs the full stop-amend flow on a real open position up to the final Confirm, then aborts, reporting pass/fail per step with captures; done when it passes 3x in a row on the operator's phone, then the live amend runs on the same logic -- so the pass streak IS the live gate.
